preconditions.description: The number of brains in the final nervous system is between 2 and 200000.
The number of parent brains specified is exactly one less than the total number of brains.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= k for k, p in enumerate(parents, start=2))
preconditions.description: Each brain k (for k from 2 to n) is connected to a parent brain p, where 1 <= p <= k-1.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n-1 latency values.

postconditions.expression: all(latencies[k-2] == max(latencies[p-2] for p in parents[:k-1]) + 1 for k in range(2, n))
postconditions.description: The latency of brain k is one more than the maximum latency of its parent brains up to k-1.
